description: REQ-16 (specs/behavioral-spec.md:64-70) establishes that human-funded note verification reads a sale event 'via the stored NOTE_SESSION_COOKIE', and REQ-15 requires per-install credential isolation with 'NO shared/Dais accounts'. CRIT-105 (contracts/sprint-2.md:28-32) requires capturing 'a real note.com draft key/URL ... its JSON output + a screenshot file ... as evidence for the human/verifier to review', and CRIT-104 (lines 23-27) requires the wiring's 'returned url/screenshot into notify.json'. No criterion in this contract requires verifying that NOTE_SESSION_COOKIE, note_mcp auth tokens, or any other stored credential is never written into notify.json, the captured JSON verify-output, or the screenshot files that CRIT-105 explicitly designates as human/browser-reviewable evidence artifacts. Evidence artifacts and notify.json commonly get committed to state/logs; a credential leaked into one of them is a real, concrete secret-handling gap that none of CRIT-101..106 gate on.

evidence.snippet: CRIT-104: "...carries the wiring's own returned url/screenshot into notify.json." / CRIT-105: "...its JSON output + a screenshot file are captured as evidence for the human/verifier to review in a browser (REQ-20)." -- neither criterion requires a check that no credential/session-cookie value is present in these artifacts.
